title: By faith (Hebrews 11:1–16)
hook: faith is the substance of things hoped for; Abraham went out not knowing
carry: the evidence of things not seen
tomorrow: who gets left off the list when the famous names run out?

segments.voice: Draw near, hold fast, and don't give up meeting, because the point of gathering is each other. Stir up love. Now Hebrews opens its long list of people who kept going.
screen: `STIR UP LOVE.` → `A LIST OF PEOPLE WHO KEPT GOING.`

segments.voice: A suitcase lies open on the bed, and the one fact you'd need to fill it is missing. Beach or snow? A week or a year? Hebrews says Abraham packed like that: "By faith Abraham, when he was called to go out into a place which he should after receive for an inheritance, obeyed; and he went out, not knowing whither he went." Not knowing whither: no address, no map. So how do you pack for that? Hebrews eleven answers with one sentence, and the rest of the chapter leans on it.
screen: `AN OPEN SUITCASE, NO ADDRESS.` → `NOT KNOWING WHITHER.` → `HOW DO YOU PACK FOR THAT?`

segments.voice: Here's the sentence: "Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen." Substance is something solid, ground you can stand on. Evidence is what convinces you. And you already live by evidence of things not seen. Keys in the front door, a bag dropped in the hall, a particular cough: you know who's home before you see them. That's the picture here. Faith isn't a blind guess. It's hearing the keys and getting up to say hello. So how does Abraham pack? Light. He lived in tents, a stranger in the very land he'd been promised. Then the chapter says something it doesn't soften: "These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them afar off." They never arrived. They saw it in the distance and greeted it anyway. They "confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth," and looked for a better country. And the chapter's answer to them: "wherefore God is not ashamed to be called their God: for he hath prepared for them a city." A tent now; a city waiting. That's the packing list.
screen: `SUBSTANCE: GROUND TO STAND ON.` · `EVIDENCE: KEYS IN THE DOOR.` · `A TENT, NOT A HOUSE.` · `SEEN AFAR OFF, GREETED ANYWAY.` · then, large: `THE EVIDENCE OF THINGS NOT SEEN.`

segments.voice: Listen for one sound whose source you can't see: a car outside, a hum in the wall, a voice in another room. Stay with that one sound through the sit, real and close, though nothing in front of you shows where it comes from.
By faith. The two words Hebrews eleven keeps coming back to, name after name, starting with Abel.
One line for today: the evidence of things not seen, like Abraham packing for a place he'd never seen. See you tomorrow.

howItsDone: Christians read Hebrews 11 in worship and study, and some pray its opening line when facing a step whose end they can't see.

myth: faith in Hebrews 11 means believing without any reason
Hebrews calls it substance and evidence: solid ground for what isn't seen yet.
Abraham knew where he was going when he left
he went out, not knowing whither he went.
Hebrews says these all died not having received the promises
they saw them afar off, and greeted them anyway.

fork.setup: your older brother has a job offer in a city he's never seen. he says he can't decide until he knows exactly how it will turn out. what would by faith look like for him?
options: wait for a sign that guarantees it works out.
take the next step without seeing the end, packing light.
go, and cut every tie with home on the way out.
fork.reveal: Abraham obeyed and went out, not knowing whither, and lived in tents: the next step taken, the end still unseen.

original.note: Greek: substance; the word behind substance in Hebrews 11:1.

trapdoor: what you thought: faith is a blind guess.
what it means: substance and evidence, living now as if the promise is real, like Abraham going out not knowing whither.
what a scholar hears: hypostasis, substance, is also the word in Hebrews 1:3, where the Son is the express image of God's person.
guess: trusting God enough to step out before you can see
being completely sure how everything will end
following rules strictly so that God rewards you
recall: gather to stir one another to love
laws written in the mind and the heart

chat.says: pop's off to rehab. invited to audition for a choir program 8 hrs away. no clue if i want it.
options: You don't have to see the end to take one step. Abraham went out not knowing whither.
Wait until you know how it ends. Hebrews says faith means being certain of the outcome first.
Go no matter what. Hebrews says faith means ignoring how you feel about leaving home.
chat.meaning: Faith is the evidence of things not seen: Abraham obeyed and went out, not knowing whither. One step can come before the whole map.

whither.meaning: an old word for to where

inheritance.meaning: what is handed on; here, the land God promised

pilgrims.meaning: travelers on a journey toward a holy place

Abel.meaning: Adam and Eve's son, first name in Hebrews 11's list

notes: Written 2026-10-13 in the year-2-4 recipe; rewritten 2026-10-15 in recipe v3. Title, word, carry and sources kept.
The KJV introduces Sarah (11:11) with 'Through faith', not 'By faith'; the word segment says the words keep coming back 'name after name, starting with Abel' (11:4), not that every name has them.
'Substance is something solid ... evidence is what convinces you' are plain glosses; the keys-in-the-door picture is the writer's illustration, not the text's. Confirm it doesn't overstate.
Trapdoor: hypostasis in 11:1 and in 1:3 ('the express image of his person'); confirm the shared Greek word.
'Looked for a better country' paraphrases Hebrews 11:14–16 ('they desire a better country').
v3 senses shape: hearing carries the idea (knowing who's home by the sound of keys); the practice is listening to one sound whose source can't be seen.

Grace storyline, day 4: Pop moves from the hospital to rehab; Grace is invited to audition for a choir program far from home and doesn't know if she wants it. Pacing: no decision yet. Practice kind: listen to one sound.
